content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 13 post groups with 92 vacancies. Groups 4, 5 and 6 are broken into lettered posts, each with its reservation category as printed. OSC and DSC stand for Other Scheduled Castes and Deprived Scheduled Castes (Note-VI of the notice), BCA and BCB for Backward Classes 'A' and 'B', and the PWD codes are as printed. The total is 3 (Sr. No. 1 to 3) + 20 + 26 + 33 + 10 (Sr. No. 7 to 13) = 92. The lettered rows add up to the group totals printed in the notice. The age limit is not given for any post.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Hindi/Sanskrit in Matric standard is an essential subject for all posts, irrespective of the qualifications below. A Ph.D. degree is considered up to the date of interview, subject to submission of the thesis as on the last date of receipt of application and production of the provisional degree certificate at the time of interview. Desirable for all three posts: administrative experience as Head of a University Department/Division of an ICAR institute. The following three conditions are printed word for word for every post at Sr. No. 4: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. degree in the discipline shown above. A Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research and/or extension in an academic/research/extension position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry, with a minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of seventy five (75) as per the criteria in Appendix II, Table 2. The notice allows a relaxation of 5% at the Bachelor's and Master's level for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Backward Classes 'A' and 'B' (Non-creamy Layer) of Haryana and for differently-abled candidates in the disability categories (a) to (e) it lists. The relaxation applies to eligibility and to assessing good academic record. The 55% eligibility marks and the 5% relaxation are based only on qualifying marks, without any grace mark procedure. The same two-route rule is printed for each of these posts, and the same 5% relaxation note as above follows it: Route A: the Master's degree above, plus the National Eligibility Test (NET) in the relevant discipline conducted by the UGC, CSIR or ICAR, or a similar UGC-accredited test such as SLET/SET. Those who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. before 11 July 2009 are governed by the rules of the awarding institution and are exempt from NET/SLET/SET if: the Ph.D. was awarded in regular mode; the thesis was evaluated by at least two external examiners; an open viva voce was held; two research papers from the Ph.D. work were published, at least one in a refereed journal; and at least two papers were presented in conferences/seminars supported by UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or a similar agency. The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned certifies this. NET/SLET/SET is also not required for Master's programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or a similar accredited test. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice carries 92 teaching posts: 3 Dean/Director posts, 20 Associate Professor/equiv., 26 Assistant Professor, 33 Assistant Scientist and 10 posts at Sr. No. 7 to 13.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for CCS HAU Advt. No. 3/2026?
faq.answer: The online portal closes on 07 December 2026 midnight. Applications opened on 07 November 2026 midnight onwards.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to send the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: A copy of the online application with self-attested uploaded documents must reach the Registrar (Recruitment Branch), CCS HAU, Hisar - 125 004 by 14 December 2026, 4.30 PM, by hand or speed post/registered post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Dean and Director posts?
faq.answer: These posts need a doctoral degree in the branches listed for each post, with at least 8 years of experience as a Professor or in an equivalent position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor posts 5A to 5H?
faq.answer: A Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject, plus NET in the relevant discipline or an exempting Ph.D., or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CCS HAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1200 (inclusive GST), Rs.300 for OSC/DSC/BCA/BCB/EWS of Haryana domicile, and Rs.600 for females of Haryana domicile (Rs.150 for those in OSC/DSC/BCA/BCB/EWS). Persons with disabilities and ESM of Haryana are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for CCS HAU teaching posts?
faq.answer: Dean and Director posts carry Rs.144200-218200 in AL-14 with unfurnished rent free accommodation, Associate Professor/equiv. posts Rs.131400-217100 in AL-13A, and Assistant Professor, Assistant Scientist and posts 7 to 13 Rs.57700-182400 in AL-10.

faq.question: Q8. Are the Dean and Director posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts at Sr. No. 1 to 3 are filled on tenurial basis for 4 years only. A person who has already served a term as Dean/Director in this or any other University is not considered for a second term.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets the reservation benefit?
faq.answer: Only OSC/DSC/BCA/BCB/Persons with Disabilities/ESM/EWS candidates who are domicile of Haryana State, with the certificate issued by the competent authority attached to the application form.

faq.question: Q10. How can a fee refund be claimed for the earlier advertisements?
faq.answer: For the 11 listed posts of Advt. No. 3/2022, 4/2022 and 2/2023, send bank account details, proof of payment, the post details and the advertisement number to [email protected] within two months from the date of publication of the advertisement.
